[SWS_UCM_00003] Cancelling the package processing
⌈
UCM
shall provide a
method
Cancel
to cancel the running package processing.
UCM
shall then abort the
current package processing task, undo any changes and free any reserved resources.
⌋
(RS_UCM_00020)
